member.name: T:Durable.Sqlite.SqliteConnectionFactory
member.summary: Opens SQLite connections, relying on Microsoft.Data.Sqlite's built-in pooling. In-memory databases stay alive for the factory's lifetime: a private ":memory:" data source is converted to a uniquely named shared-cache database so every connection from this factory sees the same data, and one connection is kept open until the factory is disposed. Thread safety: safe for concurrent use.
